verses.arabicText: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.englishText: By the mount

verses.arabicText: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
verses.englishText: And [by] a Book inscribed[1550]
verses.footnotes: [1550] Interpreted as the Preserved Slate or possibly the Qur’ān.

verses.arabicText: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
verses.englishText: In parchment spread open

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.englishText: And [by] the frequented House[1551]
verses.footnotes: [1551] The house of worship for the angels in the seventh heaven, comparable to the Kaʿbah on earth.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.englishText: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.englishText: And [by] the sea set on fire,[1552]
verses.footnotes: [1552] On the Day of Resurrection. Or "the sea which has overflowed."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.englishText: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

verses.arabicText: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
verses.englishText: Of it there is no preventer.

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
verses.englishText: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

verses.arabicText: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
verses.englishText: And the mountains will pass on, departing[1553] -
verses.footnotes: [1553] Becoming dust and moving as clouds.

verses.arabicText: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.englishText: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.englishText: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.englishText: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.englishText: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

verses.arabicText: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.englishText: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

verses.arabicText: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.englishText: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
verses.englishText: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

verses.arabicText: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.englishText: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

verses.arabicText: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.englishText: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

verses.arabicText: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.englishText: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
verses.englishText: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.[1554] Every person, for what he earned, is retained.[1555]
verses.footnotes:
[1554] i.e., the reward thereof.
[1555] i.e., subject or held responsible. Literally, "a hostage."

verses.arabicText: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.englishText: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

verses.arabicText: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
verses.englishText: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verses.englishText: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

verses.arabicText: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.englishText: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.englishText: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

verses.arabicText: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.englishText: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.englishText: Indeed, we used to supplicate[1556] Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

verses.arabicText: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.englishText: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.englishText: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?[1557]
verses.footnotes: [1557] i.e., some accident or inevitable death.

verses.arabicText: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.englishText: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

verses.arabicText: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.englishText: Or do their minds[1558] command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
verses.footnotes: [1558] In this expression is also a subtle allusion to the leaders of the Quraysh, who considered themselves to be great minds.

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.englishText: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

verses.arabicText: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.englishText: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

verses.arabicText: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
verses.englishText: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.englishText: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

verses.arabicText: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.englishText: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.englishText: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.englishText: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.englishText: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.englishText: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.englishText: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.englishText: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

verses.arabicText: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
verses.englishText: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,[1559] they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
verses.footnotes: [1559] Marking the onset of Allāh's punishment, as they had requested.

verses.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.englishText: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.englishText: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.englishText: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment[1560] before that, but most of them do not know.
verses.footnotes: [1560] If not in this world, in the grave.

verses.arabicText: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.englishText: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.englishText: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
